tips: Reached off at 144° to the wind for the first 15–40 s after the mark (your best exited at 159°). Bear away all the way to the run angle first, then set.
Gave away 26 m in the 30 s before the mark. Keep target speed on the layline; don't pinch up to the mark.
Took 47 s to settle on the run (best 29 s). Pole and halyard ready on the layline, so the set happens as you bear away.
Came out pinching at 25° to the wind (your best exited at 37°). Foot at your normal upwind angle until speed is back, then point.
Speed dropped 56% through the turn (3.06 → 1.36 kt; best 27%). A smoother, rounder turn keeps more of it.
